name: UI Watchlists RC Gate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  integration_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install bandit

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest -q \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_batch_cancel.py \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_events_stream.py \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/unit/test_ingest_jobs_batch_lookup.py
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}

  e2e_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: integration_tests
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          bun install
          bunx playwright install

      - name: Start API server
        run: |
          python -m uvicorn tldw_Server_API.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 &
          echo "Waiting for server to start..."
          sleep 5

      - name: Run e2e tests
        run: |
          TLDW_E2E_SERVER_URL=127.0.0.1:8000 \
          TLDW_E2E_API_KEY=THIS-IS-A-SECURE-KEY-123-FAKE-KEY \
          bunx playwright test e2e/workflows/media-ingest.spec.ts \
            --grep "should cancel quick ingest mid-process with confirmation" \
            --reporter=line
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: /tmp/.playwright

  bandit_scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Bandit
        run: pip install bandit

      - name: Run Bandit scan
        run: |
          python -m bandit -r \
            tldw_Server_API/app/api/v1/endpoints/media/ingest_jobs.py \
            tldw_Server_API/app/core/Jobs/manager.py \
            -f json -o /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json

      - name: Upload Bandit report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bandit-report
          path: /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json

  all_green:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [integration_tests, e2e_tests, bandit_scan]
    steps:
      - name: Verify all jobs succeeded
        uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          allowed-failures: 0
          allowed-skips: 0
